name: Hinrik the Cartographer
role: Harbour mapmaker, route witness, and Blackheads candidate-seat intelligence contact

approval.notes: Candidate-seat support record only; pending Canon Keeper review and never a new faction leader or launch-roster row.

brief.want: Make movement through Reval legible so workers and messengers are not trapped by false maps.
brief.fear: A map will become permission to seize a street, warehouse, or shoreline.
brief.contradiction: He distrusts military mapping while collecting details that could make a siege or patrol more effective.
brief.secret_or_withheld_fact: One harbour chart marks an unofficial wet-margin path whose source would be endangered if the Order knew it was known.

voice.summary: Fast, concrete, and careful around dangerous route knowledge.
voice.diction: Bearings and measurements: left bank, second gate, after the mud turns, before the bell.

outcomes.summary: Hinrik's harbour-chart hook records a Blackheads candidate event without creating a new navigation system.

source_notes.summary: P7-013 Wave A brief promoted into the P4-046 candidate-seat support corpus.
